description: Every RPC and IPC entry point that reaches the wallet's private keys: GetKey(), DecryptSecretWithMasterKey(), GetSeedPhraseBlob() or AddKeyPubKey().
key_entry_points_tests drives each row on an encrypted wallet unlocked for staking only: without a capability it must be refused, and under a capability of its kind it must not be.

rpc: {name, args, reaches} rows, refused with RPC_WALLET_UNLOCK_NEEDED unless 'refusal' says otherwise ('not_authorized': the scraper finds no key it may publish with). Under an RpcRequest capability a row must not be refused.
rpc_pool_draw: rows that hand out a key the pool holds in any scope and refuse only to make one. Driven with the pool empty, they are refused with RPC_WALLET_KEYPOOL_RAN_OUT.

ipc: {interface, method, kind, reaches} rows, refused without a capability of 'kind' (interfaces::Wallet::beginElevation()) or with one of another kind, and not refused with one of 'kind'. ipc_pool_draw as rpc_pool_draw; a row whose kind is null has no capability that lifts its refusal.
rpc_not_rows, ipc_not_rows: entry points that handle key material but reach no key of an encrypted wallet unlocked for staking only, each with its reason.

args: strings, converted as the CLI converts them. $own is an address of the wallet's, $own_pubkey its public key, $wif a fresh private key, $phrase a fresh seed phrase, $premine the regtest premine address, $psgt a PSGT spending a coin paid to $own, $rawtx the same spend as raw hex, $prevtxs the output it spends as signrawtransaction's prevtxs, $hash a 64-digit hex string, $cpid a CPID.

needs: in_sync (the node is in sync), not_ibd (out of initial block download), v15 (block version 15 active), accounts (the accounts API enabled), researcher (a CPID), scraper (the wallet's key an authorised scraper), import_file (a dump file to import), premine (the wallet holds the premine), no_seed_phrase (an HD wallet without a seed phrase), pre_hd (a wallet without an HD seed), empty_pool (the key pool empty), own_wallet (a wallet no other row runs on; rows that need the same wallet otherwise share one).

covered_by names the Boost test (suite/case) that covers a row the unit fixture cannot drive. probe names the narrowest function a row is also checked at, where the entry point's own result does not show the refusal.

Under the capability a row reaches the key code: it returns without error (a 'complete' field in its result is true), or fails after the key with the code in error_after_key, and a row that reaches AddKeyPubKey adds a key to the wallet. A row the unit fixture cannot take as far gives the reason in stops_before_key, and is checked only for not being refused.

sources: every file outside src/test/ that calls one of the four directly, with the number of calls. test/lint/lint-staking-key-access.py fails on a direct call in a file not listed here or a count that does not match, which is the prompt to add the entry point's row. Calls through the wrappers (SignSignature() and ProduceSignature(), CreateTransaction(), AddKey(), GenerateNewKey() and TopUpKeyPool(), SignPSGTInput()) are not counted, so an entry point that reaches the keys only through one of them changes no count; the inventory in key_entry_points_tests is what catches it.

rpc.name: burn
rpc.stops_before_key: Signing commits and relays the burn; the wallet has no funds, so it stops at the fee and balance checks.

rpc.name: claimhtlc
rpc.stops_before_key: Signs only for a confirmed HTLC, which the unit fixture has none of; it stops at the HTLC lookup. htlc_tests signs the claim.

rpc.name: createhtlc
rpc.stops_before_key: Signing commits and relays the funding transaction; the wallet has no funds, so it stops at the fee and balance checks.

rpc.name: importwallet
rpc.note: The dump file holds one line, a fresh private key, which the import adds.

rpc.name: consolidateunspent
rpc.stops_before_key: A consolidation that signs also commits and relays it; $own holds no coins, so there is nothing to consolidate.

rpc.name: rainbymagnitude
rpc.note: Refused only after a scraper convergence that pays an active beacon, which the unit fixture has none of. The send it then makes is CWallet::SendMoney, refused under staking only as the covering case shows.

rpc.name: refundhtlc
rpc.stops_before_key: Signs only for a confirmed HTLC, which the unit fixture has none of; it stops at the HTLC lookup. htlc_tests signs the refund.

rpc.name: restoreseedphrase
rpc.note: A wallet of its own: makeseedphrase gives the shared one a different phrase.

rpc.name: sendfrom
rpc.stops_before_key: Signing commits and relays the send; the account has no funds, so it stops at the balance check.

rpc.name: sendmany
rpc.stops_before_key: Signing commits and relays the send; the wallet has no funds, so it stops at the balance check.

rpc.name: sendtoaddress
rpc.stops_before_key: Signing commits and relays the send; the wallet has no funds, so it stops at the balance check.

rpc.name: splitunspent
rpc.stops_before_key: A split that signs also commits and relays it; it stops at the piece size, after the refusal it is driven to.

rpc.name: sweepuncoveredcoins
rpc.stops_before_key: A sweep that signs also commits and relays it; the wallet has no uncovered coins and $own is no phrase-covered destination, so it stops at the destination check.

rpc.name: walletcreatefundedpsgt
rpc.stops_before_key: Coin selection takes only coins three confirmations deep that the wallet did not send itself, and the premine is one deep; it stops at CreateTransaction's coin selection, before the inputs are signed.

rpc.name: signpsgtinpool
rpc.stops_before_key: The PSGT pool holds no entry to sign; it stops at the pool lookup.

rpc.name: advertisebeacon
rpc.note: The manual advertisement, not the automated renewal.
rpc.stops_before_key: The wallet has no confirmed funds for the advertisement; it stops at the balance check, before the beacon key is drawn.

rpc.name: advertisebeaconv3
rpc.stops_before_key: The wallet has no confirmed funds for the advertisement; it stops at the balance check, before the payload is signed.

rpc.name: createmrcrequest
rpc.stops_before_key: The CPID has no active beacon whose key would sign the claim; it stops at the beacon lookup.

rpc.name: revokebeacon
rpc.stops_before_key: The CPID has no beacon to revoke; it stops at the beacon lookup.

rpc.name: registerpool
rpc.note: Reads the new operator key, then stops at the contract's balance check with RPC_WALLET_ERROR.

rpc.name: withdrawpool
rpc.stops_before_key: The CPID has no pool registration whose operator key would sign; it stops at the registry lookup.

rpc.name: approvepool
rpc.stops_before_key: Signed with the master key, which the wallet does not hold; it stops at the contract's balance check.

rpc.name: authorizepool
rpc.stops_before_key: Signed with the master key, which the wallet does not hold; it stops at the contract's balance check.

rpc.name: removepool
rpc.stops_before_key: Signed with the master key, which the wallet does not hold; it stops at the contract's balance check.

rpc.name: addkey
rpc.stops_before_key: Signed with the master key, which the wallet does not hold; it stops at the contract's balance check.

rpc.name: sendscraperfilemanifest
rpc.note: Not an RPC error: refused, the RPC publishes nothing and returns false. The probe asks for the authorisation as the RPC does.

rpc.name: addpoll
rpc.stops_before_key: The wallet has no funds for the poll's balance claim; it stops before the claim is signed.

rpc.name: vote
rpc.stops_before_key: There is no poll to vote in; it stops at the poll lookup.

rpc.name: votebyid
rpc.stops_before_key: There is no poll to vote in; it stops at the poll lookup.

rpc_not_rows.name: backupwallet
rpc_not_rows.reason: Copies the encrypted wallet file; reads no key.

rpc_not_rows.name: encryptwallet
rpc_not_rows.reason: Makes key material only on an unencrypted wallet; an encrypted one refuses it.

rpc_not_rows.name: makekeypair
rpc_not_rows.reason: Returns a fresh random key it never stores; no wallet key is read or written.

rpc_not_rows.name: signrawtransactionwithkey
rpc_not_rows.reason: Signs only with the private keys the caller passes, in a keystore of their own.

rpc_not_rows.name: sendalert
rpc_not_rows.reason: Signs with the alert key the caller passes.

rpc_not_rows.name: sendalert2
rpc_not_rows.reason: Signs with the alert key the caller passes.

rpc_not_rows.name: walletlock
rpc_not_rows.reason: Discards the master key; reads no key.

rpc_not_rows.name: walletpassphrase
rpc_not_rows.reason: The unlock itself, proved by the passphrase.

rpc_not_rows.name: walletpassphrasechange
rpc_not_rows.reason: Re-encrypts the master key, proved by the old passphrase.

ipc.note: Dispatches any RPC; driven with signmessage. The rpc rows cover the commands it can reach.

ipc_pool_draw.note: Runs under no capability, so it never makes a key on a wallet unlocked for staking only. The GUI draws through getNewReceiveAddress and getNewReceiveAddressWithLabel.
